exact.你自己是素食者，不是因为母亲孕期吃素才不吃肉。开局随机性别、性格和家庭：家里可能: You are vegetarian by your own choice, not because your mother ate vegetarian while pregnant. The opening rolls gender, temperament, and household: the home may be meat-first, or vegetarian for a different reason. Sixteen meals run from the family table to school, work dinners, and your own stove. Guard the plate, share the table, say it plainly, prep a dish, or take a bite for the mood of the table — that bite gives no stamina. At the finale you have to close out a way of living. Just lasting to the end is not a win.
